nodes.nie.text.t: Wacław nods and stares into the fire. "Sure. I'll crawl there myself one of these days."

nodes.s.text.t: By a campfire sits a scrawny fellow with a bag full of glass. "Wacław, gatherer. With this leg of mine I'll never reach my hideout in the Glass Field. Will you take the pouch there? It's everything I own."

nodes.zgoda.text.t: Wacław hands you the pouch with care. "Don't turn it to the light. That's when the glass starts telling what it's seen."
